title: Karl Mayer Group turns 85
content: This year, the Karl Mayer Group turns 85 years old, and the German textile machinery leader is using the anniversary as an opportunity to pay tribute to the people behind its unparalleled success story. The new headquarters of the Karl Mayer Group in Obertshausen. What was once a family business, has developed into an international group of companies at the top of its markets. “Today, we look back on a group of companies with strong roots and business activities in the main sectors of the textile industry. The Group also continued to expand in the recent past: in 2020, the flat knitting machine manufacturer Stoll was acquired, and since 2021, the new Beyond Textile Business Unit has been committed to growth outside its traditional business areas in the textile world. In addition to the voices from the market, a new presentation on the group of companies and an anniversary video on the theme of ‘People, togetherness, insights’ will be launched.

title: KARL MAYER | LinkedIn
content:
Overview:
KARL MAYER is a mechanical engineering company that offers a wide range of products and services of its sector with the focus on textile machinery building. The business activities are concentrated on the fields of warp knitting, technical textiles and warp preparation for weaving. KARL MAYER supports the success of its international customers with products and services that are outstanding in both economic and technical terms, as well as with innovations that move the textile world forward. KARL MAYER has employees all over the world. Thanks to its global organization and its claim to produce in its main markets, the company is always close to its customers and their needs. Today, it has subsidiaries in the USA, India, Italy, Hong Kong, Japan, China, Turkey, India and Switzerland, as well as agencies in all parts of the world. KARL MAYER is a German family-owned company, which has focused on financial independence and economic sustainability since its foundation in 1937. As a permanent, reliable partner with decades of experience and a high level of quality in all areas, it supports the competitiveness of its customers and business partners. content: ## Knitting Industry's Post. ### **Knitting Industry**. New investors sought by flat knitting machine builder Stoll... World leading textile machinery group Karl Mayer has denied claims that its Karl Mayer Stoll site in Reutlingen, Germany, is set for closure, after the group’s decision to exit the flat knitting sector. Speaking to the GEA, however, Wittel refuted claims suggested by readers of the newspaper that the site faced closure. While headquartered in Obertshausen, the flat knitting machine division in Germany primarily operates from the Reutlingen site, which handles production, sales and service and currently employs 286 people.
